name: env_ac_epiap1
alternateName: Environmental protection investments by ancillary producers
description: Annual environmental protection investments by ancillary corporate producers, broken down by CEPA/CReMA activity, NACE Rev. 2 economic activity, and environmental/economic investment type. The experiment filters this dataset to nace_r2 = 'EP_BSN' (business sector total) and env_econ in {'EPS_INV_PT', 'EPS_INV_PP'} (end-of-pipe + integrated technologies), then sums by (geo, year, ceparema) to obtain a single ancillary investment value per cell. Values are reported in millions of Euro.

recordSet.name: env_ac_epiap1
recordSet.description: One row per combination of the categorical dimensions; each year column (2014-2022) carries the measurement for that year in wide format. Year columns outside the 2014-2022 analysis window are present in the raw CSV but not enumerated here.

field.name: freq
field.description: Eurostat observation frequency code. Always 'A' (annual) in these extracts.

field.name: unit
field.description: Eurostat unit-of-measurement code (e.g. MIO_EUR, NR, CLV20_EUR_HAB). Numeric values in this CSV are in the unit indicated by this column.

field.name: geo
field.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (plus Eurostat aggregates such as EU27_2020). The original CSV header is 'geo\\TIME_PERIOD'.

field.name: env_econ
field.description: Environmental investment type (e.g. EPS_INV_PT = end-of-pipe technologies; EPS_INV_PP = integrated technologies).

field.name: nace_r2
field.description: NACE Rev. 2 economic activity classification. EP_BSN = total business sector excluding household / government.
